"U12H181T00" and "REV. 1 GP" is silkscreened on the main [http://img-fotki.yandex.ru/get/6726/20776875.3/0_f8bbf_8ac41534_orig.jpg board]. :OEM: [[Foxconn]] U12H181T00 ==Links of Interest== ===Wikis=== *[http://www.dd-wrt.com/wiki/index.php/Netgear_WNDR4000 On the '''DD-WRT''' Wiki] *[http://wiki.openwrt.org/toh/netgear/wndr4000 On the '''OpenWrt''' Wiki] ===Reviews=== *[http://www.smallnetbuilder.com/wireless/wireless-reviews/31474-netgear-wndr4000-n750-wireless-dual-band-gigabit-router-reviewed ''Netgear WNDR4000'' Reviewed on '''SmallNetBuilder'''] :C4:3D:C7 OUI ===Forum threads=== *[http://www.dd-wrt.com/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?t=90474 On the '''DD-WRT''' forums] *[http://www.dd-wrt.com/phpBB2/viewtopic.php?t=90600 On the '''DD-WRT''' forums] ===Third party firmware support=== This device should be well supported by '''DD-WRT''' (see wiki + forum posts below) :and partially supported by '''OpenWrt''' ([http://downloads.openwrt.org/barrier_breaker/14.07/brcm47xx/mips74k/openwrt-wndr4000-squashfs.chk Barrier Breaker (14.07) build]). While there is an '''OpenWrt''' build available, b43 currently lacks 11n support.
